title: Denominator ledger
description: Machine-checkable form of the canon rule 'no percentage without its base' (docs/CITATION_MASS_CANON.md §1). One row per published measure: the value, its unit, the base it is a percentage of, the machine source that produced it, and a provenance class. Generalizes the PD canon ledger (csl-atlas/data/pd/pd_canon_ledger.tsv, 12 TSV columns) to any corpus. Cross-row invariants (enforced by scripts/validate-denominator-ledger.mjs, not expressible in JSON Schema): (1) measure_id unique; (2) pct_of_base present => pct_kind present, and the base is carried per kind: share_of_base requires base_id resolving to another row's measure_id, covered_over_value carries its base in-row (covered_works over the row's own value); (3) every percentage recomputes from the ledger's own values within rounding.

measure_id.description: Stable row key, snake_case (TSV column 1: measure_id).

label.description: Human label of the measure (TSV column 2: label).

unit.description: Counting unit (TSV column 4: unit). Open set; the reference PD ledger uses rows and sigla.

base_id.description: measure_id of the denominator row when the measure carries a percentage (TSV column 5: base_id).

covered_works.description: Count of covered works when the measure is coverage-shaped (TSV column 6: covered_works).

pct_of_base.description: The published percentage over the named base, one decimal (TSV column 7: pct_of_base).

pct_kind.description: The denominator relation (TSV column 8: pct_kind). covered_over_value: covered material over this row's own value. share_of_base: this row's value over base_id's value.

source_file.description: Machine artifact the number is read from, repo-relative or cross-repo path (TSV column 9: source_file).

provenance.description: How the number came to be (TSV column 11: provenance). observed: measured on the machine text. recorded: recorded by the producer, not re-derived. press: external print count. derived: computed from other ledger rows.

note.description: Free note, including retirement/retraction semantics (TSV column 12: note).
